issues.detail: The Hebrew 'בְנֵי יוֹנָה' means 'young pigeons' (literally 'sons of a dove'), but the Chinese renders it as '兩隻鴿子的兒子' ('sons of two pigeons'), which misidentifies the referent: the Hebrew has 'two young pigeons' (two birds that are young doves), not 'sons of two pigeons' (offspring of two pigeons). This changes the meaning of the sacrificial animal.
